summary: r003: Fixed G1 FAIL by setting project_inputs.span_length_m to 38.3 in all three new grammars (i_girder, box_girder, composite_i_girder) to match the locked design basis DB-SUPERT-38M.json. Checked span-dependent parameters (depth ranges, girder spacing, slab thickness, prestressing layouts, concrete grades) and found none require adjustment: all families can produce valid sections at 38.3m within their declared grids. test_design_basis.py passes; test_section_types.py passes (16/16); full suite has 1 pre-existing failure in test_shape_grammar_experimental.py (stale expected file list, BRD-028 scope).
unresolved_risks: Box girder L1 line-girder results remain outside model validity (type-k distribution factor span, torsion not modeled, shear model from Super-T does not apply to box webs). Composite I-girder is hard-blocked by SOLVER-COMPOSITE-001 until a composite solver is implemented. Both families carry claim_ceiling IDEA in the design basis. No new risks introduced by the span correction.
